case: MySQL dollar text does not open a PostgreSQL dollar-quoted span
contract: A MySQL statement containing $tag$ followed by a semicolon splits at that semicolon; dollar-quoted bodies are dialect-specific.
The regression test kills the mutation that combines the unsupported-dialect and non-dollar-start guards with AND instead of OR.

The bounded subprocess test covers nested and ordinary comments, quoted strings, bracket identifiers, dollar-quoted bodies, statement separators and Unicode; it kills nonterminating mutants without hanging the test runner.
A focused 24-mutant run covers every mutation location from the earlier timeout rechecks and catches all 24 with zero misses or timeouts.
